_comment: Merge into .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json) of a THROWAWAY
test repo, not a real one. Answers: does the 'if' field accept alternation,
e.g. 'Bash(dotnet *)|Bash(msbuild:*)'? If so, one filtered handler can
replace denoizinator-net's unfiltered handler without violating C4 (one
handler per plugin) and without paying a pwsh launch on every Bash call.
Reuses probes/hook-behavior/hook-logger.ps1 unmodified -- it is generic,
keyed only by -Label, one JSON file per invocation (no shared-file
contention).
'all-bash' is the unfiltered control, same role as in hook-behavior/. Any
command present in 'all-bash' but absent from an alternation label that
should have matched it is a coverage gap -- alternation does not work.
'if-alt-broad' tests the exact string from the spec's open question.
'if-alt-narrow' tests a three-way alternation, to rule out alternation
working only for the single-wildcard case.
'if-single-known-good' is a CONFOUND CONTROL, not a question this probe
exists to answer: it carries the exact first clause of if-alt-narrow with
no '|' in it, known-good from docs/hook-behavior-findings.md section 1.
If it doesn't fire on 'dotnet build', 'if' filtering itself is broken in
whatever session ran the probe (e.g. headless -p mode, or a mid-session
settings reload) and the alternation result cannot be trusted.
